result.brief: 提出 LongSCOP 长视频外扩方法：自强制训练、潜空间校准与未来参考提升长时序稳定性，并用 VLM 智能体选取参考帧保持语义一致，同时构建 62K 数据与 LVO-Bench 基准。
result.reason: Long video outpainting with self-forcing training, latent calibration and VLM-selected reference frames; directly addresses long-horizon video generation stability and semantic consistency.
